worked_example_GLM_GM.paper_reference: GLS Appendix A GM: FROE 0.397/0.345/0.289 fading -0.0144/yr to 0.160 at year 12, r=13.94%; reproduced here at full precision (implied P0 48.5114 vs red-team's 48.4869, a 0.05% rounding difference; round-trip is exact at 13.94%).
